data.body: AC amendment: Specify error handling for missing/malformed absence-claim-anchors.json. When absence-claim-anchors.json is missing, unreadable, or fails json.load, the validator MUST fail closed with a descriptive error to stderr and non-zero exit — NOT silently disable absence-claim detection. The task description currently specifies a soft fallback to minimal anchors; this must be changed to fail-closed (exit 1 with clear stderr). This ensures the integrity of the gate is preserved even on corrupt installs.
